name: The Pit Lane Ballet
prompt: Bend a miniature race circuit around an open service court. One car brakes onto its mark, a crew changes two wheels, and another car accelerates past the grandstand.

name: Rain on the Hairpin
prompt: Place a wet test corner and a dry corner side by side. Drivers take sharply different lines while marshals push a wheeled sprinkler back toward its tank.

name: The Pedal Grand Prix
prompt: Run pedal-powered racers around a compact banked track. A mechanic adjusts a chain below the timing stand while a tight group rounds the last bend.

name: The Timber Velodrome Garage
prompt: Fit a steep timber motoring bowl around a sunken repair yard. A light racing car takes the banking above spectators peering into the open engine bays below.

name: The Tyre Library
prompt: Arrange a racing test loop around racks of wheels with distinct tread patterns. Crews exchange tyres at the pit exit while a white dust strip records the returning car's track.
